pairs: to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter
to beat, to give a beating (typically not badly)
to beat out, to knock out, to dislodge
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: разби́ть — to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter; поби́ть — to beat, to give a beating (typically not badly); сби́ть — to knock down; вы́бить — to beat out, to knock out, to dislodge.
**побил** — поби́ть (perfective): to beat, to give a beating (typically not badly); to beat (a record); to break. Wiktionary: по- + бить.
